task: Carry the box to the exit. Whenever the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) and Existence(holding_box) are both hard and match the commanded 'carry the box to the exit'. The environment's exit condition enforces holding the box on the exit step. ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) matches 'on your very next move' and is hard, as the task's 'whenever' rule is a requirement. Compiler clues show no redundant clauses and no added requirements.

texts: Carry the box, so the agent holds it at some point on the way to the exit.
Whenever the box falls, the agent picks it up again on the very next step, so it is held on that next step.
